expected_level_description: You can: - coach and lead teams in Agile and Lean good practices - create and tailor the right approach for a team, challenging, evaluating and iterating the approach through the life cycle - experiment with new and innovative ways of working to improve delivery across the organisation - act as a recognised expert and advocate for Agile and Lean approaches

You can: - advocate for a range of effective research approaches across the organisation - coach others in making decisions that meet user needs across a range of channels - advocate for continuous use of user insights in teams - use user insights to make strategic decisions to provide the best user experience

You can: - advocate for user needs, ensuring user value is balanced against cost and value for the organisation - determine the benefit of a product and persuade others it's the right product to use - write or contribute to business cases - communicate business-value propositions - help others make value-based decisions, influencing the direction of development

You can: - lead and coach teams through different phases of the life cycle - ensure effective support for the product or service and its users - predict, prevent, mitigate and manage potential risks at different phases of the life cycle - contribute to the assessment of other teams, providing guidance and support

You can: - lead product teams to create effective methods for measuring product outcomes - advocate for data-driven decision making - help others prioritise to make better choices - use data to drive continuous improvement, increasing quality and user experience - identify opportunities to share and connect product data

You can: - seek opportunities for reuse and learning across your organisation - represent product management in your area in conversations with senior stakeholders - protect teams, for example, from unnecessary distractions and requests to change direction - coach and manage others in product management - lead some product management community activities and participate in cross-government communities

You can: - set the strategy and vision for your products, collaborating with others - create a prioritised roadmap for your products and use it to discuss product strategy at all levels - plan prioritised work across multiple teams, minimising dependencies and risks - support multiple teams in delivering quality outcomes in the right way - coach and mentor others in product management

You can: - direct the stakeholder relationship strategy for your teams - ensure stakeholder's objectives are set and support teams to meet them - influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders to resolve issues and enable progress

You can: - support and coach others in creating and implementing a successful long-term strategy and tactical approach that others agree with - influence and persuade stakeholders to support delivery of the strategy - support with strategic decision making - ensure strategic alignment across the organisation

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload

You can: - lead hazard identification and risk assessment for a product or change - write and maintain hazard logs and clinical safety case reports - agree risk controls with product teams and check that they work - advise teams on applying clinical risk management standards

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements
You can: - follow a software life cycle process that meets medical device standards - produce the records that such a process requires
You can: - carry out equality impact assessments - build inclusive teams and practices
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - track spending against a small budget and raise variances - authorise spending within your limit
